name: 48796-longprefill-gemma34b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: Concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bound at 256 requests, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%.
workload: Long-context text-only prefill via guidellm `synthetic_text`: one turn, 16384 prompt tokens fixed (min=max), 64 output tokens fixed, temperature 0, static seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing 16k-token texts for eight concurrent users on a single H100 GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit dbcc1cdd0a7b41a75f14e3e432cce52072862a6b. No released wheel is this tree;
# `configs/env.yaml` says where the interpreter lives on this machine.
# Everything not listed here is left at the engine default.

model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 0}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 32768
